LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Scorched Girl
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Scorched Girl (F-01-02) is an ember-wreathed TETH Abnormality.\nOnce her fuse ignites upon breaching containment, she sprints toward the nearest person and detonates in a fiery Red blast within 20 seconds unless suppressed beforehand.
